source_inputs: MCGM storm-water drains, status Existing/Proposal retained
OSM named roads for location cues only
method: Flag cells whose DSM 10th-percentile elevation is at/below the ward-grid 25th percentile and whose mapped Existing-drain length per clipped cell area is at/below its ward-grid 25th percentile. Proposal drains are measured and shown separately and excluded from the screen. This is an evidence-gap review shortlist, not a flood-risk score or impact prediction.
limitations: DSM is a surface model with buildings/vegetation and 30 m nominal spacing; it is not an engineering bare-earth or hydrologically conditioned model.
Drain lines are mapped records, not proof of capacity, connectivity, current condition, or operation. Missing mapped lines do not prove no drainage exists.
250 m cells and relative ward percentiles are exploratory reporting bins; thresholds are not calibrated flood thresholds.
Nearest OSM road is a location cue, not an official locality name.
No verified temporary-shelter capacity, open status, safe route, or operational evacuation destination is available in the local data.
